title: SLIDING WAVES
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 3 "balance & Rory O'More right · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers are not in a straight line.

Row 6 "partners swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 8 "circle left 3 places AND PASS THRU TO WAVE OF FOUR · circle" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 8 "circle left 3 places AND PASS THRU TO WAVE OF FOUR · pass through" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
The progression after row 8 "circle left 3 places and pass thru to wave of four · ocean-wave" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
Row 3 "balance & Rory O'More right · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 3 "balance & Rory O'More right · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 4 "balance & Rory O'More left · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 4 "balance & Rory O'More left · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction.
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.
Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
